title: Vanishing on a finite thickening implies zero-section kernel-power membership
statement: Let $A$ be any commutative ring, $d\ge0$, $B=A[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], $I=(X_1,\ldots,X_d)$, and $V\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}B$ any open [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For $n\ge0$, let $q_n:\operatorname{Spec}(B/I^n)\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ be the quotient map and $z:\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ the constant-coefficient zero section. If $t\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O)$ pulls back to zero on $q_n^{-1}(V)$, then for every $x\in z^{-1}(V)$ its germ at $z(x)$ belongs to $\ker(\mathcal O_{V,z(x)}\to\mathcal O_{z^{-1}(V),x})^n$. No depth, locality, Noetherian or punctured-open hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tag 0EY9 (lemma-fully-faithful-power-series-over-depth2), first displayed inverse-limit calculation at a fixed index, before taking the inverse limit; the subsequent comparison of rings

proof.text: For n=0 the ideal power on the right is the unit ideal. For n>0, fix x in z inverse-image V with prime p in A, and let Q be the inverse image of p under constant coefficient. Each variable has zero constant coefficient, so I is contained in Q and Q gives a point of Spec(B/I^n) lying over z(x); this point belongs to q inverse-image V.

In the canonical localization coordinates, the stalk map of q is B_Q to (B/I^n)_(Q/I^n). Its kernel is I^n B_Q: a fraction maps to zero exactly when a denominator outside Q kills its numerator modulo I^n. Localization commutes with ideal powers, so this ideal is (I B_Q)^n. The ideal I B_Q is contained in the kernel of the zero-section stalk map because constant coefficient kills every variable.

Open restriction preserves these stalks and their germ maps. Naturality identifies the germ of the pulled-back section with the image of the original germ under the quotient stalk map. The hypothesis that the section pulls back to zero puts its germ in that map kernel, namely (I B_Q)^n. The inclusion I B_Q in the zero-section stalk kernel gives the required inclusion of n-th powers.

theorem powerSeries_punctured_germs_mem_pow_of_thickening_zero
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (d : ℕ)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens) (n : ℕ) :
    let I : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A) := Ideal.span (Set.range MvPowerSeries.X)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)))
    let z := Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)))
    ∀ t : Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤), ((q ∣_ V).appTop).hom t = 0 →
      ∀ x : (z ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme,
        (V.toScheme.presheaf.Γgerm ((z ∣_ V) x)).hom t ∈
          (RingHom.ker ((z ∣_ V).stalkMap x).hom) ^ n
